A hardcore RPG skillset, a vast map, massively customisable sandbox and a cute tutorial raccoon await the unwary. So how will you die? All it takes is a bite..

title: Sid Meier’s Civilization VI
description: Expand your empire, advance your culture and go head-to-head against history’s greatest leaders. Will your civilization stand the test of time?

dlc.title: New Frontier Pass
dlc.description: Continue your quest to build your greatest empire with the Civilization VI - New Frontier Pass, featuring eight new civilizations and nine new leaders, and a variety of new gameplay content, including six new game modes.

dlc.title: Gathering Storm
dlc.description: Civilization VI: Gathering Storm introduces an active planet where geology and climatology present unique new challenges.

dlc.title: Rise and Fall
dlc.description: The Civilization VI: Rise and Fall expansion brings new choices, strategies, and challenges for players as they guide a civilization through the ages.

dlc.title: Leader Pass
dlc.description: Rethink how you rule with the Civilization VI: Leader Pass! Discover new paths to world domination with 18 new leader selections. New content is available free for current and new owners of Civilization VI Anthology.

title: Total War: WARHAMMER III
description: The cataclysmic conclusion to the Total War: WARHAMMER trilogy is here. Rally your forces and step into the Realm of Chaos, a dimension of mind-bending horror where the very fate of the world will be decided. Will you conquer your Daemons… or command them?

dlc.title: UPGRADE PACK
dlc.description: Upgrade your Total War: WARHAMMER experience with Total War: WARHAMMER III’s original factions and Legendary Lords or wage total war to decide the fate of the Warhammer world across the Realms of Chaos campaign mode.

dlc.title: Forge of the Chaos Dwarfs
dlc.description: The Forge of the Chaos Dwarfs campaign pack introduces a new brutal race, the Chaos Dwarfs, into Total War: WARHAMMER III, in both the Realm of Chaos and Immortal Empires campaigns.

dlc.title: Total War: WARHAMMER II - Curse of the Vampire Coast
dlc.description: Dread prows pierce the gloom ahead, and the ghastly truth is laid bare: upon the ghoul-winds come the swollen hulks and decaying vessels of the Vampire Coast! Run now – run hard and fast. For it is all you can do.

dlc.title: Total War: WARHAMMER II - Rise of the Tomb Kings
dlc.description: Across the arid deserts of Nehekhara, vast legions of skeletal warriors rise from beneath the baking sands to slaughter those who trespass into their domain.

title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition
description: 42 Civilizations, 229 Campaign Missions, Singleplayer, Co-Op, Multiplayer, In-Game Editor, Mods, Cross-play...It is good to be the king.

dlc.title: Dynasties of India
dlc.description: This expansion brings three new civilizations of India plus three full new campaigns to Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition for the first time.

dlc.title: Dawn of the Dukes
dlc.description: Welcome to Dawn of the Dukes, the second new official expansion to Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition. Challenge friends with two additional civilizations as well as new units and technologies.

dlc.title: Lords of the West
dlc.description: Welcome to Lords of the West, the first new official expansion to Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition. Challenge friends with two additional civilizations, new units and tech and enjoy three new single player…

dlc.title: Age of Empires II: DE - The Viking Sagas
dlc.description: Unleash the fury of the North and lead the Danes, Saxons, and Varangians into epic Viking battles.

title: Stellaris
description: Explore a galaxy full of wonders in this sci-fi grand strategy game from Paradox Development Studios. Interact with diverse alien races, discover strange new worlds with unexpected events and expand the reach of your empire. Each new adventure holds almost limitless possibilities.

dlc.title: Nomads
dlc.description: In Nomads, you thrive inside colossal Arkships that carry your people, your industry, and your ambition across the stars.

dlc.title: BioGenesis
dlc.description: Take command of the forces of life itself in Stellaris: BioGenesis. Engineer living ships, terraform entire ecosystems, and wield advanced genetic tools to shape the destiny of your empire.

dlc.title: The Machine Age
dlc.description: It is an age of technological glory, rapid social change, and unbridled ambition… But in the depths of space, a danger unlike any before encountered is about to emerge, a looming threat that will throw the very meaning…

dlc.title: Shadows of the Shroud
dlc.description: The psionic plane holds untold power—but at what cost? Shadows of the Shroud is a complete overhaul of the Psionic Ascension path, introducing new moral dilemmas, patron allegiances, and the ever-present temptation of…

title: XCOM 2
description: XCOM 2 is the sequel to XCOM: Enemy Unknown, the 2012 award-winning strategy game of the year. Earth has changed and is now under alien rule. Facing impossible odds you must rebuild XCOM, and ignite a global resistance to reclaim our world and save humanity.

dlc.title: War of the Chosen
dlc.description: XCOM 2: War of the Chosen adds extensive new content in the fight against ADVENT including new soldier classes, enemies, missions, maps and more. Requires XCOM 2 game. Sold separately.

dlc.title: War of the Chosen - Tactical Legacy Pack
dlc.description: The XCOM 2: War of the Chosen - Tactical Legacy Pack includes a collection of new game modes, maps, weapons, armors, Photobooth options, and more that honors the legacy of the XCOM series.

dlc.title: Resistance Warrior Pack
dlc.description: Customize your squad of resistance fighters with a set of bonus outfits and head gear, as well as custom armor and face camo. Instantly unlock a survivor of the old war as a new recruit in your barracks.

title: Cities: Skylines
description: Cities: Skylines is a modern take on the classic city simulation. The game introduces new game play elements to realize the thrill and hardships of creating and maintaining a real city whilst expanding on some well-established tropes of the city building experience.

dlc.title: Plazas & Promenades
dlc.description: Say Goodbye to noise and pollution and Hello to pedestrian streets, car-free areas, and modern plazas. It’s time to level up your Cities with this environment-friendly expansion!

dlc.title: Sunset Harbor
dlc.description: Ahoy! Cities: Skylines - Sunset Harbor introduces the fishing industry, new mass transit options, and important city services.

dlc.title: Industries
dlc.description: layers can customize their industrial areas with supply chains for the four different resource types and unique factories. Well managed industry areas will level up and become more efficient.

dlc.title: Parklife
dlc.description: Cities: Skylines - Parklife is a playful new expansion, making your city more alive with new amusement parks, nature reserves, city parks and zoos, and giving new life to your empty land with custom parks and gardens.

title: Factorio
description: Factorio is a game about building and creating automated factories to produce items of increasing complexity, within an infinite 2D world. Use your imagination to design your factory, combine simple elements into ingenious structures, and finally protect it from the creatures who don't really like…

dlc.title: Space Age
dlc.description: Factorio: Space Age continues the player's journey after launching rockets into space. Discover new worlds with unique challenges, exploit their novel resources for advanced technological gains, and manage your fleet of…

title: Satisfactory
description: Satisfactory is a first-person open-world factory building game with a dash of exploration and combat. Play alone or with friends, explore an alien planet, create multi-story factories, and enter conveyor belt heaven!

title: RimWorld
description: A sci-fi colony sim driven by an intelligent AI storyteller. Generates stories by simulating psychology, ecology, gunplay, melee combat, climate, biomes, diplomacy, interpersonal relationships, art, medicine, trade, and more.

dlc.title: Odyssey
dlc.description: Build your own ship and travel across the planet! Explore exotic biomes, expand your mobile colony, and launch into space. Scavenge ancient tech on asteroids, abandoned space stations, and satellites.

dlc.title: Anomaly
dlc.description: Darkness stirs on the rim. Survive flesh infestations, cultist attacks, shambling undead, blood rains, invisible hunters, and other sanity-shredding perils. Capture and study entities to harness the power of the void.

dlc.title: Biotech
dlc.description: Control mechanoids, raise a family with children, and play with genetic modifications. Fight or ally with xenohuman factions and explore the dark secrets of the blood-drinkers.

dlc.title: Ideology
dlc.description: What do you believe? RimWorld - Ideology adds belief systems to the game. Play as piratical nudist cannibals, blind undergrounder mole people, charitable ranching cowboys, machine-obsessed transhumanists, and many more.

title: Stardew Valley
description: You've inherited your grandfather's old farm plot in Stardew Valley. Armed with hand-me-down tools and a few coins, you set out to begin your new life. Can you learn to live off the land and turn these overgrown fields into a thriving home?

title: Dota 2
description: Every day, millions of players worldwide enter battle as one of over a hundred Dota heroes. And no matter if it's their 10th hour of play or 1,000th, there's always something new to discover.

title: Forza Horizon 5
description: Explore the vibrant open world landscapes of Mexico with limitless, fun driving action in the world’s greatest cars.

dlc.title: Car Pass
dlc.description: Get 42 extra cars at one low price! The Car Pass will deliver 34 new cars to your game weekly, one per week. As a bonus, you’ll also receive 8 Formula Drift Cars to get you started.

dlc.title: VIP
dlc.description: Forza Horizon 5 VIP Membership features exclusive rewards that give your game a boost and make you stand out at the Horizon Festival.

dlc.title: Hot Wheels
dlc.description: Forza Horizon 5: Hot Wheels is included with the Forza Horizon 5 Premium Edition, Expansions Bundle, and Premium Add-Ons Bundle. This add-on requires Forza Horizon 5 (game sold separately).

dlc.title: Rally Adventure
dlc.description: FORZA HORIZON 5 RALLY ADVENTURE is included with the Forza Horizon 5 Premium Edition, Expansions Bundle, and Premium Add-Ons Bundle. This add-on requires Forza Horizon 5 (game sold separately).

spotlight.blurb: Explore the vibrant open world landscapes of Mexico with limitless, fun driving action in the world’s greatest cars.

title: Assetto Corsa
description: Assetto Corsa v1.16 introduces the new "Laguna Seca" laser-scanned track, 7 new cars among which the eagerly awaited Alfa Romeo Giulia Quadrifoglio! Check the changelog for further info!

dlc.title: Ferrari 70th Anniversary Pack
dlc.description: The Ferrari 70th Anniversary Celebration Pack introduces seven iconic cars, including the SF70H, the sixteenth car produced by Ferrari to compete in the F1 World Championshipone of which has been chosen by our community!

dlc.title: Dream Pack 1
dlc.description: The DREAM PACK 1 is the first add-on content pack ASSETTO CORSA: it adds to Assetto Corsa the legendary circuit of Nürburgring-Nordschleife and ten new awesome cars.

dlc.title: Dream Pack 2
dlc.description: Welcome to DREAM PACK 2, the newest add-on content pack ASSETTO CORSA. This package adds to Assetto Corsa the circuit of Catalunya (Barcelona) and seven new awesome cars in nine total versions.

dlc.title: Dream Pack 3
dlc.description: Welcome to DREAM PACK 3, the newest add-on content pack ASSETTO CORSA. This package adds to Assetto Corsa the legendary circuit of Brands Hatch (UK) and eight new awesome cars in nine total versions.

title: Euro Truck Simulator 2
description: Travel across Europe as king of the road, a trucker who delivers important cargo across impressive distances! With dozens of cities to explore, your endurance, skill and speed will all be pushed to their limits.

dlc.title: Nordic Horizons
dlc.description: Deliver cargo through the captivating landscapes of northern Scandinavia!

dlc.title: Iberia
dlc.description: The Iberian Peninsula is full of rich and diverse landscapes, from semi-arid southeastern deserts to the green coniferous forests.

dlc.title: Road to the Black Sea
dlc.description: Get ready to start your engines and deliver cargo around the countries of Romania, Bulgaria and Turkey. Featuring 20 new major cities, 22 new companies to deliver with, an extensive road network and much more.

dlc.title: Beyond the Baltic Sea
dlc.description: Beyond the Baltic Sea DLC brings to Euro Truck Simulator 2 the countries of Lithuania, Latvia and Estonia, parts of western Russia, and the south of Finland.

title: Need for Speed Unbound
description: Race to the top, definitely don’t flop. Outsmart the cops, and enter weekly qualifiers for The Grand: the ultimate street race. Pack your garage with precision-tuned, custom rides, and light up the streets with your style.

dlc.title: Ultimate Collection Upgrade
dlc.description: The Ultimate Collection Upgrade is the ultimate catch-up pack. Instant access to all post-launch premium content. Get access to 9 fully customizable cars, over 45 Customs, and hundreds of additional cosmetics.

dlc.title: Trick or Street Swag Pack
dlc.description: Make an entrance with the new Trick or Street Swag Pack, containing a one-off Legendary Custom clothing pack inspired by the golden age of American animation, a Skeleton Head mask, a driving effect, & more.

dlc.title: Hip Hop Origin Swag Pack
dlc.description: Take to the streets & celebrate the origins of hip-hop.

dlc.title: Robojets Swag Pack
dlc.description: Switch lanes with the premium pack containing a one-off Legendary Custom and an incredible range of uniquely designed items.

title: eFootball
description: Step up and experience the exhilarating soccer game that has now surpassed 1 billion downloads! Play eFootball with users around the world!

title: Street Fighter 6
description: Here comes Capcom’s newest challenger! Street Fighter 6 launches worldwide on June 2nd, 2023 and represents the next evolution of the Street Fighter series! Street Fighter 6 spans three distinct game modes, including World Tour, Fighting Ground and Battle Hub.

description: TEKKEN 8 is the latest addition to the TEKKEN series, the pinnacle of 3D fighting games. Join the fight with over 32 characters and bear witness to the next installment in this epic saga. Get ready for the biggest and best TEKKEN game ever made!

dlc.title: Season 2 Character & Stage Pass
dlc.description: The Season 2 Character & Stage Pass includes the following content: 4 Additional playable characters and 2 Additional battle stages.

dlc.title: Season 1 Character & Stage Pass
dlc.description: The Season 1 Character & Stage Pass includes the following content: 4 Additional playable characters, 2 Additional battle stages, Character Costume: Gold Suit Pack, Avatar Costume: Classic TEKKEN T-Shirt Set, and 4…

dlc.title: Season 3 Pass
dlc.description: The Season 3 Pass includes the following content: 4 additional playable characters, 1 additional battle stage, and the Character Costume: Aurora Outfit Pack.

dlc.title: Season 2 Character Pass
dlc.description: The Season 2 Character Pass includes the following content: 4 Additional playable characters.

title: Mortal Kombat 1
description: Discover a reborn Mortal Kombat Universe created by the Fire God Liu Kang. Mortal Kombat 1 ushers in a new era of the iconic franchise with a new fighting system, game modes, and fatalities!

dlc.title: Definitive Edition Upgrade
dlc.description: Upgrade your Mortal Kombat 1 base game with instant access to the Story Expansion, Kombat Pack, Kombat Pack 2, Mortal Kombat and II Movie Skins, Dragon Krystals, and more!

dlc.title: MK1: Khaos Reigns Expansion
dlc.description: Includes Story Expansion + Kombat Pack 2 Available at Launch: Noob Saibot Cyrax Sektor Available Post-Launch (includes early access): Ghostface (Scream Franchise) T-1000 (Terminator 2) Conan the Barbarian

dlc.description: Includes: Fighters Omni-Man (Invincible) Quan Chi Peacemaker (DC Peacemaker) Ermac Homelander (The Boys) Takahashi Takeda Kameos Tremor Khameleon Janet Cage Mavado Ferra JCVD Skin for Johnny Cage

dlc.title: MK1: Kameo Unlock Pack
dlc.description: Jumpstart Mortal Kombat 1 with 5 classic Kameo characters in this pack. Kameos include: Sub-Zero Scorpion Kung Lao Shujinko Motaro Kameo characters are unlockable through play.

title: Among Us
description: An online and local party game of teamwork and betrayal for 4-15 players...in space!

title: Overcooked! 2
description: Overcooked returns with a brand-new helping of chaotic cooking action! Journey back to the Onion Kingdom and assemble your team of chefs in classic couch co-op or online play for up to four players. Hold onto your aprons… it’s time to save the world again!

dlc.title: Season Pass
dlc.description: This content requires the base game on Steam in order to play.

dlc.title: Night of the Hangry Horde
dlc.description: This content requires the base game on Steam in order to play. Night of the Hangry Horde is available for free for all players who have purchased the Overcooked! 2 Season Pass!

dlc.title: Carnival of Chaos
dlc.description: Overcooked! 2 Carnival of Chaos invites players to a celebration of all things cooking, co-op and chaos! This colourful new DLC will put players to the test as you take on combo meals and that kitchen essential, the…

dlc.title: Campfire Cook Off
dlc.description: This content requires the base game on Steam in order to play.

title: DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR'S CUT
description: From legendary game creator Hideo Kojima comes a genre-defying experience, now expanded in this definitive DIRECTOR’S CUT. As Sam Bridges, your mission is to deliver hope to humanity by connecting the last survivors of a decimated America. Can you reunite the shattered world, one step at a time?

title: Grand Theft Auto V Enhanced
description: Experience entertainment blockbusters Grand Theft Auto V and Grand Theft Auto Online — now upgraded for a new generation with stunning visuals, faster loading, 3D audio, and more, plus exclusive content for GTA Online players.

title: Riders Republic
description: Jump into a massive multiplayer playground! Bike, ski, snowboard, or wingsuit across an open world sports paradise where the rules are yours to make or break.

dlc.title: Careers Pack
dlc.description: With the Careers Pack, unlock skate and BMX! Comes with over 30 new events and 150+ pieces of gear. Master new tricks and dominate the competition! Riders Republic is required to play this extension.

dlc.title: Blind Spot Pack Riders Republic
dlc.description: Receive 2,500 Republic Coins and a Legendary outfit, including a pair of shoes and an emote. Use Coins to unlock toys and sport add-ons, or purchase extra cosmetic items for your rider!

dlc.title: Motor Pack
dlc.description: With the Motor Pack, unlock the rocket skis, snowmobile, jumbo bike, rocket bike, and dirt bike. Riders Republic is required to play this extension.

dlc.title: X-TREME Board Pack
dlc.description: With the X-TREME Pack, unlock the longboard, hoverboard, mountainboard, and snowskate. Riders Republic is required to play this extension.

title: MotoGP25
description: Rev up your engines for the 2025 season! Feel the authentic MotoGP thrills with refined sound design and exciting challenges. Train with new disciplines in Race Off mode and choose the Arcade or Pro Experience for ultimate fun or realism!

dlc.title: Off Road Helmets Pack
dlc.description: Give your custom rider a stylish head start with this pack of 6 additional off-road helmets and their dedicated liveries!

dlc.title: Iconic Liveries Pack
dlc.description: Style up your training with 10 special liveries for Minibikes, Motard and Flat Track bikes, inspired by the most iconic MotoGP graphics.

title: PGA TOUR 2K25
description: Take your best shot at glory in PGA TOUR 2K25! In a 2K-first, compete in three prestigious major tournaments. Personalize your game with expanded MyCAREER, MyPLAYER and Course Designer options. Challenge friends across ranked, casual, and cross-platform multiplayer.

dlc.title: Member’s Pass
dlc.description: Includes PGA TOUR 2K25 Clubhouse Pass Premium for Seasons 1-5 and Clubhouse Gear Pack. Access additional seasonal quests, boosts, and valuable items. Clubhouse Gear Pack includes one outfit per body type per season.

dlc.title: Pro Accelerator Bonus Pack
dlc.description: You didn’t show up for second place and you’re not waiting to compete. 8800 VC 5 X LVL↑ Tokens 12 X Fittings Puma Footwear Limited Edition Ping Iron 6 X Evo Tools

dlc.title: Year 2 Member's Pass
dlc.description: Includes PGA TOUR 2K25 Clubhouse Pass Premium for Seasons 6-8 and Clubhouse Gear Pack Year 2. Get access to additional seasonal quests to earn extra boosts and valuable items.

dlc.title: Starter Pack
dlc.description: Tee off strong with the PGA TOUR 2K25 Starter Pack: •1 Evo Tool: Increase Club Set or Ball performance •5 Level-Up Tokens: Level up a Club Set or Ball •5 Club Fittings: Customize club attributes for your playstyle •3…

title: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 1 + 2
description: Play the fully-remastered Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater & Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 2 games in one epic collection, rebuilt from the ground up in incredible HD.

title: Descenders
description: Descenders is extreme downhill freeriding for the modern era, with procedurally generated worlds, and where mistakes have real consequences. Will you lead your team to glory and become the next legendary Descender?

title: SnowRunner
description: Get ready for the next-generation off-road experience! Drive powerful vehicles and overcome extreme open environments to complete dozens of challenging missions solo or with up to 3 friends!

dlc.title: Sabertooth Livery
dlc.description: Customize your SnowRunner experience with the Sabertooth Livery DLC, available exclusively for the Heavy Duty Derry Longhorn 4520!

dlc.title: Season 16: High Voltage
dlc.description: Welcome to Washington! High Voltage tasks you with building a hydropower plant across 3 large maps with the help of 3 new trucks. Season 16 is SnowRunner’s fourth expansion and is included in the Year 4 Pass.

dlc.title: Season 12: Public Energy
dlc.description: Season 12: Public Energy is included in the Year 3 Pass. Requires the base game SnowRunner to run. North Carolina’s state government needs you to assist in the establishment of a nuclear power station and to help local…

dlc.title: Season 8: Grand Harvest
dlc.description: This product is included in the Year 2 Pass for SnowRunner. After a streak of crop failures and poor harvests, operate three new vehicles to restore sustainable farming activities and alternative energy sources in the…
